question: Which tree shadows must the wise practitioner avoid stepping on?
premises: Stepping on a shadow is prohibited.
The wise one is the subject of the rule.
The shadows are of bibhītaka and karañja trees.
inference: The wise practitioner must not step on the shadows of bibhītaka and karañja trees.
plain_english: The wise one should not step on the shadow of the bibhītaka and karañja trees.
